-- SQL Server 示例，后继存储过程写这------------
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_merge_order_info
AS
BEGIN
    MERGE ods_order_info AS target
    USING tds_order_info AS source
    ON target.id = source.id
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET 
            target.name = source.name,
            target.email = source.email,
            target.updated_at = GETDATE()
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (id, name, email, created_at)
        VALUES (source.id, source.name, source.email, GETDATE());
END


CREATE PROCEDURE sp_merge_order_info
AS
BEGIN
    MERGE ods_order_info AS target
    USING tds_order_info AS source
    ON target.id = source.id
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET                
                target.consignee              =target.consignee             ,
                target.consignee_tel          =target.consignee_tel         ,
                target.total_amount           =target.total_amount          ,
                target.order_status           =target.order_status          ,
                target.user_id                =target.user_id               ,
                target.payment_way            =target.payment_way           ,
                target.delivery_address       =target.delivery_address      ,
                target.order_comment          =target.order_comment         ,
                target.out_trade_no           =target.out_trade_no          ,
                target.trade_body             =target.trade_body            ,
                target.create_time            =target.create_time           ,
                target.operate_time           =target.operate_time          ,
                target.expire_time            =target.expire_time           ,
                target.process_status         =target.process_status        ,
                target.tracking_no            =target.tracking_no           ,
                target.parent_order_id        =target.parent_order_id       ,
                target.img_url                =target.img_url               ,
                target.province_id            =target.province_id           ,
                target.activity_reduce_amount =target.activity_reduce_amount,
                target.coupon_reduce_amount   =target.coupon_reduce_amount  ,
                target.original_total_amount  =target.original_total_amount ,
                target.feight_fee             =target.feight_fee            ,
                target.feight_fee_reduce      =target.feight_fee_reduce     ,
                target.refundable_time        =target.refundable_time
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (id                    ,
                consignee             ,
                consignee_tel         ,
                total_amount          ,
                order_status          ,
                user_id               ,
                payment_way           ,
                delivery_address      ,
                order_comment         ,
                out_trade_no          ,
                trade_body            ,
                create_time           ,
                operate_time          ,
                expire_time           ,
                process_status        ,
                tracking_no           ,
                parent_order_id       ,
                img_url               ,
                province_id           ,
                activity_reduce_amount,
                coupon_reduce_amount  ,
                original_total_amount ,
                feight_fee            ,
                feight_fee_reduce     ,
                refundable_time
                )
        VALUES (target.id                    ,
                target.consignee             ,
                target.consignee_tel         ,
                target.total_amount          ,
                target.order_status          ,
                target.user_id               ,
                target.payment_way           ,
                target.delivery_address      ,
                target.order_comment         ,
                target.out_trade_no          ,
                target.trade_body            ,
                target.create_time           ,
                target.operate_time          ,
                target.expire_time           ,
                target.process_status        ,
                target.tracking_no           ,
                target.parent_order_id       ,
                target.img_url               ,
                target.province_id           ,
                target.activity_reduce_amount,
                target.coupon_reduce_amount  ,
                target.original_total_amount ,
                target.feight_fee            ,
                target.feight_fee_reduce     ,
                target.refundable_time
                );
END

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ctl_external_source
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'abfss://ctl@sahyivy.dfs.core.windows.net/',
    CREDENTIAL = WorkspaceIdentity
);


CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT csv_format
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS (
        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
        STRING_DELIMITER = '"',
        FIRST_ROW = 2, -- 跳过标题行
        ENCODING = 'UTF8'
    )
);

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE table_primary_keys (
    table_name VARCHAR(128),
    column_name VARCHAR(128)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '/primary_keys/table_primary_keys.csv', -- 存储路径
    DATA_SOURCE = ctl_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = csv_format
)
AS
SELECT 'orders' AS table_name, 'order_id' AS column_name;

INSERT INTO table_primary_keys (table_name, column_name)
VALUES ('order_info', 'id');


-- 查询外部表数据
SELECT * FROM table_primary_keys;

--sp
CREATE PROCEDURE sp_merge_table 
    @table_name SYSNAME
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        -- 1. 定义变量
        DECLARE 
            @source_table SYSNAME,
            @target_table SYSNAME,
            @join_condition NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
            @update_set NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
            @insert_columns NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
            @insert_values NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
            @sql NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @pk_columns NVARCHAR(MAX);

        -- 2. 根据约定构建源表和目标表名 (例如: tds_<table_name>, ods_<table_name>)
        SET @source_table = 'tds_' + @table_name;
        SET @target_table = 'ods_' + @table_name;

        -- 3. 尝试从元数据表获取主键列 (推荐方法)
        -- 假设存在一个名为 'table_primary_keys' 的元数据表，包含 table_name, column_name 列
        SELECT @pk_columns = COALESCE(
            (SELECT STRING_AGG(column_name, ', ') 
             FROM table_primary_keys 
             WHERE table_name = @table_name), 
            ''
        );

        -- 4. 如果没有找到元数据，则使用启发式方法或默认列（例如 'id'）
        IF LEN(@pk_columns) = 0
        BEGIN
            -- 示例：假设每个表都有 'id' 列作为主键
            SET @pk_columns = 'id';
            -- 更安全的做法：可以查询 INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 检查 'id' 列是否存在
            -- 如果也不存在，则可以抛出错误或使用其他逻辑
        END

        -- 5. 构建 MERGE 语句的动态部分
        -- 5.1 构建 JOIN 条件 (基于主键列)
        SELECT @join_condition = (
            SELECT STRING_AGG('target.' + QUOTENAME(value) + ' = source.' + QUOTENAME(value), ' AND ')
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@pk_columns, ', ')
        );

        -- 5.2 构建 UPDATE SET 子句 (更新所有非主键列)
        SELECT @update_set = (
            SELECT STRING_AGG(QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME) + ' = source.' + QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME), ', ')
            FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
            WHERE TABLE_NAME = @target_table
                AND COLUMN_NAME NOT IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT(@pk_columns, ', '))
        );

        -- 5.3 构建 INSERT 子句
        SELECT 
            @insert_columns = STRING_AGG(QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME), ', '),
            @insert_values = STRING_AGG('source.' + QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME), ', ')
        FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
        WHERE TABLE_NAME = @target_table;

        -- 6. 组合完整的动态 MERGE 语句
        SET @sql = '
        MERGE INTO ' + QUOTENAME(@target_table) + ' AS target
        USING ' + QUOTENAME(@source_table) + ' AS source
        ON (' + @join_condition + ')
        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET ' + @update_set + '
        WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
            INSERT (' + @insert_columns + ')
            VALUES (' + @insert_values + ')
        WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN
            DELETE;'; -- 可选：根据需求决定是否删除目标表中源表不存在的记录

        -- 7. 打印生成的 SQL 语句（用于调试，可选）
        PRINT @sql;

        -- 8. 执行动态 SQL
        EXEC sp_executesql @sql;

        PRINT 'MERGE operation completed successfully for table: ' + @table_name;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        -- 错误处理
        DECLARE @error_message NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        DECLARE @error_severity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY();
        DECLARE @error_state INT = ERROR_STATE();
        
        PRINT 'Error occurred: ' + @error_message;
        -- 可以选择将错误信息记录到日志表
        -- INSERT INTO error_log (table_name, error_message, error_time) VALUES (@table_name, @error_message, GETDATE());
        
        -- 重新抛出错误
        RAISERROR(@error_message, @error_severity, @error_state);
    END CATCH;
END;

EXEC sp_merge_table @table_name = 'order_info';
